name: Distract Assailant
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level mesmerist 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You make a motion and the target becomes convinced there is an enemy near them they did not anticipate.

They are treated as if they flanked for 1 round. If the target has improved uncanny dodge, all attackers are treated as having your caster level as their rogue level for the purposes of being able to use their existing sneak attack against the target.
